69/69 pass. One targeted fix:

**`FloydWarshallTest.java` — `assertDistMatrix`**

Before: called `assertEqual("vertexCount", n, r.vertexCount())`, which on mismatch incremented `failed` and then continued into the loop — where `r.getDistance(i, j)` with an out-of-range `i` would throw an uncaught `IndexOutOfBoundsException`, crashing the test runner entirely.
